description: Tutorial Jr. Sentinel (MeowDB monster 1, a Peace monster) in the isometric 3D world: its stone proxy body, movement model, AI timings and its touch rule. Gameplay stats (level, HP, EXP, P.DMG, ACC, AVOID, KB, the speed modifier, the touch zone, the sprite size and the animation times) are NOT repeated here: MonsterDef reads them from data/canonical/monsters/1.json. The values every species shares (the terrain probes, the wander rhythm, the model fit, the hop and fall tolerances) come from monsters/_shared.json; a key named here overrides the shared value. Owner: the monster system (docs/runtime/MONSTERS_AND_COMBAT_RUNTIME.md).

reasons.model: Iteration Three's Tutorial Jr. Sentinel proxy in assets/world/_library.glb (src/misostory/kit/creatures.py Mob_TutorialJrSentinel: a small stone sentinel with one glowing eye, after MeowDB's 'a training dummy ... target practice'; MeowDB publishes stats, not art, and no MapleStory sprite is used). Iteration One built none, and Iteration Two showed a grey procedural stand-in. Fitted to the canonical sprite height (68 px x WorldScale.actor = 1.7 m), its body is about as wide as the 21 px touch zone and its head 1.2x.
reasons.placeholder_color: The stone grey of the fallback body MonsterVisual builds only when the library lacks the proxy (a missing export); it carries the monster's name, never the word placeholder.
reasons.capsule_radius_m: Physics body only (kill plane, debug overlays); half the canonical touch-zone width, 21 px x 0.025 m/px / 2 = 0.26 m.
reasons.capsule_height_m: The canonical touch-zone height, 36 px x WorldScale.actor (the sprite is taller, 68 px, than its touch zone).
reasons.walk_style: Presentation: the stone sentinel bobs a little per step (MeowDB publishes clip lengths, not motion).
reasons.speed_model: MeowDB publishes a speed modifier (speed -60) but no monster speed formula. px/s = slope of MeowDB's walk line (1.25 px/s per Speed point) x (base Speed 100 + modifier), without the character-only '+20 Speed behind the scenes': 1.25 x 40 = 50 px/s x WorldScale.h = 1.0 m/s.
reasons.movement_kind: Canonical movement label 'Stays on its floor'.
reasons.idle_s: MeowDB does not publish how long a monster stands or walks; the sentinel is a calm tutorial target, so it stands a little longer.
reasons.walk_s: Random walk of 1.0-3.0 s between stands (unpublished).
reasons.touch_rule: MeowDB gap (monsters.md 'Peace monster touch damage'): the page says 'Peace' ('Non-aggressive, won't attack unless provoked'; analysis: 'Safe to walk past.') yet also shows a 21x36 touch zone with Touch DMG 1-1 (Base 1). MisoStory reads both literally: walking into an unprovoked Tutorial Jr. Sentinel does nothing; once the player has hit it, it is provoked for the rest of its life and its touch zone deals contact damage through the normal formula (P.DMG 1). Unverified until MeowDB settles it.
